B.subject: Chemistry
B.text: Given (M/10) solution of potassium ferrocyanide is 46% dissociated at 18°C. It's osmotic pressure is (0.785 + x) atm. Find x
B.sol_text:
Answer : 06.00
Solution:
Normal osmotic pressure = (W/m×V) × R × T
(when no dissociation has taken place)
W/m = 0.1, V = 1 litre, R = 0.082
T = 18 + 273 = 291 K
Normal osmotic pressure = (0.1/1) × 0.0821 × 291
= 2.389 atm
Potassium ferrocyanide is an electrolyte. It dissociates as
K₄[Fe(CN)₆] ⇌ 4K⁺ + [Fe(CN)₆]⁴⁻
       1-α        4α      α
Total number of particles = 1 - α + 4α + α
= 1 + 4α
α = 0.46; So, 1 + 4α = 1 + 4 × 0.46 = 2.84
Observed osmotic pressure / Normal osmotic pressure = 2.84/1
Observed osmotic pressure
= 2.84 × 2.389
= 6.785 atm

A.text: The set of all values of 'b' for which the function f(x) = (b² - 3b + 2)(cos²x - sin²x) + (b - 1)x + sin 2 does not have stationary points is
A.sol_text:

A.text: A differentiable function f : R⁺ → R satisfies the function condition f(x) - f(y) ≥ ln(x/y) + x - y for all x, y ∈ R⁺. If g(x) = f'(x), then the value of Σ(n=1 to 100) g(1/n) is

x = a, y = β

x = β, y = a

A.text:
Let f(x) = lim(n→∞) (log(2+x)-x^(2n) sin x)/(1+x^(2n)), then
f(x) is discontinuous at
A.sol_text:

  ∞       x^2 > 1       x ∈ (-∞,-1) ∪ (1,∞)

  1       x^2 = 1       x = ±1
}

  -sin x                x < -1 or x > 1

}

L.H.L. = lim(h→0) f(1-h) = lim(h→0) log(2+1-h) = log 3

R.H.L. = lim(h→0) f(1+h) = lim(h→0) -sin(1+h) = -sin 1

So R.H.L ≠ L.H.L

Similarly at x = -1, L.H.L = 0, R.H.L = sin 1

So, it is discontinuous at x = 1, -1

A.text: If A − (I/2) and A + (I/2) both are orthogonal matrices, then
options: A is a symmetric matrix of odd order

A is a skew symmetric matrix of even order

(A − (I/2))(A − (I/2))^T − I ⇒ (A − (I/2))(A^T − (I/2)) = I
⇒ AA^T − (AI/2) − (A^T I/2) + (I/4) = I ...(1)
(A + (I/2))(A + (I/2))^T = I
⇒ AA^T + (AI/2) + (A^T I/2) + (I/4) = I ...(2)
From (1) − (2) AI + A^T I = 0 ⇒ A + A^T = 0
⇒ A^T = −A ⇒ A is an skew symmetric
From (1) + (2), AA^T = (3I/2) ⇒ |A| ≠ 0
⇒ A is skew symmetric matrix of even order

B.sol_text:

Solution:
Let f(x) = sin(sin(sin x)), here f(x) < 1
Clearly one root of f(x) = x/3 is 0 and there will be no root if |x| > 3
∴ f'(0) = 1 and f''(x) ≤ 0 ∀ x ∈ [0, π]
So f(x) is monotonic in (0, ∞) and has almost one root (ray α) in (0, π)
Hence f(x) is monotonic in [0, α) and in (α, π)
Also f(π) = 0, so there will be exactly one positive root in (α, π)
∴ f(x) is odd function so there will be another root in (−π, −α)

B.text: Let A, B, C be three commutative square matrices of same order with real entries such that AB + BC + CA = I and |A + B| = 0. The value of |A + B + C − ABC| is equal to
B.sol_text:

Hint : Simplify by post multiplication with C.
Sol. : BA = I − AC − BC
⇒ BAC = C − AC² − BC² = C − (A + B)C²
⇒ C − BAC = (A + B)C²
⇒ A + B + C − BAC = A + B + (A + B)C²
= (A + B)(I + C²)
⇒ |A + B + C − BAC| = |A + B||I + C²| = 0
